rules.justification: Allow GitHub reads and the reviewable writes the delivery workflow uses; other forms of an approved gh prefix change GitHub in ways the sandbox cannot undo.

Allow a reply to a review comment on a furedea repository's pull request: only one -f body (no -F, --field, or --input, which read files), an optional POST method, and a jq filter or --silent; other owners, endpoints, methods, and fields ask.

Allow a GraphQL query that reads GitHub: the document must start as a query and contain no mutation keyword in any case, variables are plain -f words or -F numbers and booleans (never @file input), and a second query or operationName asks.
Allow GitHub reads that ask for a media type or API version by header; every other word must be literal, so no expansion can add an option beside the header.

Allow a single plain curl call, with value-less flags (-s -S -f -i -I -v) and fixed -X, -H, -d, -o, and single-quoted -w/--write-out diagnostic formats, stdout-only -D/--dump-header, and --compressed, to a local server named exactly localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1]; -o is limited to /dev/null, and -d cannot start with @ (file input). Only Accept, Content-Type, and User-Agent headers are allowed (case-insensitive, without control characters): local dev checks need response media selection, request body typing, and client identification, without credentials, cookies, or host/routing overrides; any assignment, redirect, wrapper, list, or option that follows redirects, reads a config file, or sets a proxy asks, and wget, which follows redirects by default, asks except for its help and version.

Allow read-only container inspection; docker runs outside the sandbox and reaches host files through mounts, copies, env files, build contexts, and compose files, so every other form, including global options and docker-compose, asks.
Allow Herdr reads and handing work to a new Claude or Codex session; repository trust, pane environments, other agent kinds, and driving existing panes run outside the sandbox and ask.
Allow watching lanes and their worktrees; every word must be literal, so no expansion can add an option such as --trust-repository.

Allow local Go builds, verification, and inspection; go env -w and -u change user-level Go configuration, and go run pkg@version fetches and executes a remote module the project's go.mod does not pin, so those forms ask.

Let agents drive a browser outside the sandbox to navigate, read, and act on pages; only the listed subcommands, after at most --json, --headed, or --session, qualify, and the guard lets each subcommand use only the options it lists. Every file the browser's daemon writes (screenshot and pdf other than a bare screenshot or screenshot --full, trace stop, profiler stop, network har stop) asks, because the daemon opens a relative path from the directory it started in, which the arguments cannot show; so does any argument naming an absolute, home, or parent-directory path, and every unlisted subcommand or alias (connect, upload, download, state, diff, inspect, which opens the default browser through macOS open, profiles, which reads the user's Chrome Local State, doctor, plugins, MCP calls, chat, batches, auth, install, upgrade), because they reach the user's logged-in sessions, files the sandbox denies, or run other code. Each word must be a whole quoted or bare token, and the form must also match with quotes removed, so quoting cannot hide a subcommand or option.

Let agents operate desktop apps outside the sandbox that a command names; a window-targeting command must name its app with --app, because without it the target is whichever window has focus, and the guard lets each subcommand use only the options it lists, so window IDs, physical input (--headed), trace and screenshot files, and permission requests ask. Keyboard and pointer input to the focused window or a screen position, batches, and launching an app (a name or path may reach a bundle the session wrote) ask, because the arguments cannot tell which app they reach. Each word must be a whole quoted or bare token, and the form must also match with quotes removed.
